Document Management Platform
=============================

A different sample document with some overlapping content.

Overview
--------
This document management platform offers various features for handling documents in organizational settings. The system enables efficient document workflows and collaboration.

Main Capabilities:
- Text analysis and extraction
- Search functionality
- Quality metrics
- Data protection compliance
- Entity extraction
- Version control

Architecture
------------
Built with modern Python technologies and incorporates AI/ML components for intelligent document processing.
